channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: SCO slams attacks, sanctions on Iran: Key takeaways from Bishkek summit
item.description: The SCO started in 1996 and accounts for 43 percent of the world’s population and 23 percent of the global economy.

item.title: Video: SCO summit leaders meet in aftermath of US war on Iran
item.description: Leaders are meeting in Kyrgyzstan for the annual Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit.

item.title: Why China will not comply with US sanctions on Iran
item.description: Beijing will not comply with US measures because it can and because it’s in its interest not to.

item.title: Iran urges US to honour commitments under MoU
item.description: Tehran calls for Washington to respect terms of MoU after attacks send tensions soaring in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: At least five killed as ammunition-laden vehicle explodes in Syria’s Idlib
item.description: Several also injured in incident that took place in Idlib countryside, state media reports.

item.title: ‘Hit them hard’: Does Trump have another ‘new’ Iran strategy, can it work?
item.description: Trump signals harsher response as US-Iran hostilities escalate, raising fears of prolonged conflict in the Gulf region.

item.title: Abroad and at odds: How the war has divided Iranians in the diaspora
item.description: Many Iranians in the diaspora remain caught in the paradox of opposing the war and the government in Tehran.

item.title: Israeli strikes on Gaza kill at least five, including children
item.description: Al Jazeera correspondent reports 'nonstop' attacks on Gaza City. Israel's Katz asserts strikes were protecting troops.

item.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
item.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

item.title: Israel says senior Hamas member seized as strikes kill three during Gaza raid
item.description: Reports say the Israeli military carried out strikes after a raid by Israeli special forces and Israel-backed Palestinian militiamen was discovered.
